description: This file defines the 'MetadataHeader' interface in Java, which models an association between a MetadataHeaderKey and a JsonValue. It includes factory methods for creating instances and parsing from JSON, as well as comparison logic. It also contains inner classes for defining JSON fields relevant to MetadataHeader objects.

classes.name: MetadataHeader
classes.description: An interface representing a metadata header that associates a MetadataHeaderKey with a JsonValue, with comparison and JSON parsing capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a MetadataHeader instance from a key and a value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a MetadataHeader instance parsed from a JSON object.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of this header.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of this header.
